text: Two questions before launch: who inside Wrenfield can see which document sets, and how does an update to this system actually ship safely.
With Lena Ortiz, Security and Compliance: none of the three document sets is confidential today, so V1 ships with all three visible company-wide -- a decision to revisit, not a permanent one.
With Caleb Shaw: the FastAPI backend ships as a Docker image to Azure Container Apps, with revision-based rollout -- a bad change can roll back without a redeploy.
One more standing plan: Lena's team periodically red-teams the system's real outputs and monitors what it actually tells people, on an ongoing basis, not just once before launch.
Next: the first real implementation lesson -- building the actual ingestion pipeline against Wrenfield's real documents.
